primary_metric: Pearson correlation between estimated_z_obj and true z_obj on held-out non-anchor items

learners.no_auxiliary_learner: Uses y only and returns rank-normalized y for non-anchor items.
learners.with_auxiliary_calibration_learner: Uses y, u, and repeated anchor observations to estimate relative observer bias; returns y minus estimated bias for non-anchor items.

controls.C1: Shuffle auxiliary labels; recovery must fail.
controls.C2: Remove calibration anchors; recovery must fail.
controls.C3: Generate observations independent of z_obj; recovery must fail.
controls.C4: Audit that u, anchors, and fitting procedures do not leak true z_obj.
